title: Rescheduled Event Across All Formats
tests: Propagates a date correction across both still assets and every dated reel frame without changing other event details or leaving stale versions.

exact_text.read_as: Rooftop Jazz (poster and story; not visible in supplied reel frames)
24 October 2027 (both images and all supplied reel frames)
7 PM (poster and story; not visible in supplied reel frames)
Atlas Roof (poster and story; not visible in supplied reel frames)
Free entry (poster and story; not visible in supplied reel frames)

faults.what: Every supplied reel frame displays '17 October 2027' above '24 October 2027'; the old date was retained rather than replaced, creating conflicting event information.
The supplied reel frames lack 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry', so the reel does not communicate the required event details.

judge.summary: The poster and story show the revised details correctly, but the reel retains the old date alongside the new one and lacks the other required event information in the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The revised poster, story image and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
must_haves.why: The exact revised date is legible in both images and all four supplied reel frames.

must_haves.item: The old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
must_haves.why: Although absent from the two images, the old date is clearly visible in all four supplied reel frames.

must_haves.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry' without alteration.
must_haves.why: Both images contain all four exact strings, but none is visible in the supplied reel frames.

must_haves.item: The revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy designs, imagery and layouts apart from the date replacement.
must_haves.why: The revised assets share a cream-and-burgundy rooftop jazz aesthetic, but no original assets are provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The final pack contains two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: Two separate images are supplied, with a 4:5 poster and vertical story, plus a vertical reel identified as 10 seconds long.
